title: Independent audit of scoped DEX trade activity daily metrics
objective: Independently verify the separate daily DEX transaction and trade-leg activity blueprints, schema constraints, card semantics, and offline boundaries before any Dune, PostgreSQL, or CardKit execution.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized daily aggregate reporting. This audit is read-only except for its report; it must not execute Dune, PostgreSQL, Feishu, Hermes, Lark, or provider operations.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify production code, tests, migrations, query definitions, runtime configuration, or any task specification.
Do not execute Dune queries, PostgreSQL writes, migrations, CardKit sends, Hermes, lark-cli, external providers, backfills, or chain adapters.
Do not read, print, persist, or commit Dune credentials, DATABASE_URL, Feishu target IDs, tokens, cookies, or raw provider payloads.
Do not approve changes to existing G1/S1/B1/R1 capital query SQL or their historical query versions.

Do not approve a trade leg as a user trade, wallet, buyer, seller, smart-money event, net liquidity event, active pool, market-cap/FDV, Kline, graduation, cohort, recommendation, score, or full Robinhood measure.
Do not approve BSC or Robinhood beyond their declared aggregate Dune registry; Robinhood must remain Uniswap v2/v3/v4 partial coverage with an explicit qualifier.
